ValidationRule.description: Enterprise accounts with annual revenue over 10M must have an Industry and a valid 10-digit Phone number.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Customer - Direct"), AnnualRevenue > 10000000, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Industry)), NOT(REGEX(Phone, "^\\D*(\\d\\D*){10}$")) ), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Validation_Rules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enterprise direct customers (revenue over $10M) require an Industry and a valid 10-digit phone number.
